summary: Updated implementation plan adding the Gemini AI Audio Transcription tool for audio logging across all 6 Indian languages (English, Hindi, Kannada, Tamil, Telugu, Marathi). Users can record microphone audio via MediaRecorder or upload audio files, which are processed by Gemini multimodal audio to transcribe speech and extract structured financial transactions. Also includes the Landing Page, Auth Gateway (Google Sign-In + Email/Password), and Multi-Turn Gemini Saathi Chatbot.
